{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, cream #F1E7D3, merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, mid-rise, ankle length so the hems stay dry, deep olive #4E5A3C, wool-blend crepe
Belted trench coat, single-breasted, knee length, with a storm flap and a hood, warm sand #B79B72, water-repellent cotton gabardine
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, rubber grip sole, chocolate brown #5B3F2F, suede with a waterproofing treatment
Compact structured tote bag, medium size, cognac #9A5B34, water-resistant grained leather
Large umbrella, automatic, dark forest green #2F3E32, windproof polyester
Silk-blend scarf, loosely knotted, soft sage #A9B8A0, matte twill

This outfit suits a neat office day. The sweater and tailored trousers look polished, and the ankle-length hem keeps the suede boots out of the puddles on the walk. The warm cream, olive and sand tones flatter her golden hair, warm skin and grey-green eyes. The trench coat and umbrella cover the all-day rain, and the sage scarf echoes her eye color. The suede boots she asked for stay central, and the waterproofing treatment makes them practical for a wet autumn commute."}
